# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# Common architecture-independent Kconfig options

# This file is included from the top-level Kconfig file.

config 64BIT
	bool
	help
	  Indicates that the architecture is 64-bit. The toolchain will
	  be selected based on this.

config STACK_POINTER_SHIFT
	int
	default 0
	help
	  If the stack pointer is not aligned to a word boundary, this is the
	  number of bits to shift it to the right to get the word-aligned
	  stack pointer.

config HAS_IMMEDIATE_IRQS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a way to deliver
	  interrupts immediately, without going through the normal interrupt
	  handling path.

config ARCH_HAS_USERSPACE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports user mode.

config ARCH_HAS_MMU_PT_PD_SIZE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a way to specify
	  the size of the page table and page directory.

config CPU_HAS_MMU_FLAG_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the CPU has hardware support for memory
	  management unit flags.

config ARCH_HAS_STACK_PROTECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports stack
	  protection.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_ABORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports thread
	  abortion.

config ARCH_HAS_RAMFUNC_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture supports placing
	  functions in RAM.

config ARCH_HAS_NESTED_EXCEPTION_DETECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a way to detect
	  nested exceptions.

config ARCH_HAS_GDBSTUB
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has GDB stub support.

config ARCH_HAS_CPU_IDLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a CPU idle
	  implementation.

config ARCH_HAS_NANO_TIMEOUT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a nano-second
	  resolution timeout implementation.

config ARCH_HAS_COVERAGE_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has coverage support.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has thread local
	  storage support.

config ARCH_HAS_DEMAND_PAGING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has demand paging
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_RESERVED_PAGE_FRAMES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has reserved page
	  frames support.

config ARCH_HAS_TIMING_FUNCTIONS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has timing functions
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_SYSTICK
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a systick timer.

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_SWAP_TO_MAIN
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom swap to
	  main function.

config ARCH_HAS_CUSTOM_BUSY_WAIT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a custom busy
	  wait function.

config ARCH_HAS_IRQ_VECTOR_TABLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an IRQ vector
	  table.

config ARCH_HAS_GEN_SW_ISR_TABLE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a generated
	  software ISR table.

config ARCH_HAS_DYNAMIC_OBJ_LINKING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has dynamic object
	  linking support.

config ARCH_HAS_ADDITIONAL_META_INFO_SECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an additional
	  meta info section.

config ARCH_HAS_NO_EXEC_STACK_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has no-execute stack
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_STACK_CANARIES
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has stack canaries
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_LAZY_REG_STACK_SWITCH
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has lazy register
	  stack switch support.

config ARCH_HAS_FPU_SHARING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has FPU sharing
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_INTERRUPT_CONTROLLER
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an interrupt
	  controller.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_STACK_SENTINEL
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has thread stack
	  sentinel support.

config ARCH_HAS_EXTRA_EXCEPTION_INFO
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has extra exception
	  info support.

config ARCH_HAS_SW_VECTOR_RELAY
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has software vector
	  relay support.

config ARCH_HAS_MULTITHREADING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has multithreading
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_PM
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has power management
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_SINGLE_THREAD_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has single thread
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_ATOMIC_H
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an atomic.h
	  header file.

config ARCH_HAS_ATOMIC64_H
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an atomic64.h
	  header file.

config ARCH_HAS_SET_GDT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a set_gdt
	  function.

config ARCH_HAS_LOG_OUTPUT_SUPPORT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has log output
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_POINTER_WIDTH
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a pointer width
	  defined.

config ARCH_HAS_PROCESS_EXECUTION_MEMORY
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has process execution
	  memory support.

config ARCH_HAS_KOBJECT_MEMORY_SLAB
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has kobject memory
	  slab support.

config ARCH_HAS_KOBJECT_ALLOC_SIZED
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has kobject alloc
	  sized support.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_STATISTICS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has thread statistics
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_EXCEPTION_STACK_SIZE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an exception
	  stack size defined.

config ARCH_HAS_SYSTEM_CALLS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has system calls
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_INSTRUMENT_THREAD_SWITCHING
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has instrument
	  thread switching support.

config ARCH_HAS_SMP
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has SMP support.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_LOCAL
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has thread local
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_THREAD_STRUCT_FIELDS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has thread struct
	  fields support.

config ARCH_HAS_IDLE_HOOK
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an idle hook.

config ARCH_HAS_ABORT_HANDLER
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has an abort handler.

config ARCH_HAS_SPINLOCK
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has spinlock support.

config ARCH_HAS_UNALIGNED_ACCESS
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has unaligned access
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_MEM_PROTECT
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has memory protection
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_HW_STACK_PROTECTION
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has hardware stack
	  protection support.

config ARCH_HAS_ATOMIC_SWAP
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has atomic swap
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_ATOMIC_IOP
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has atomic iop
	  support.

config ARCH_HAS_BUILTIN_STACK_GUARD
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has built-in stack
	  guard support.

config ARCH_HAS_FLUSH_L1_CACHE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a flush l1 cache
	  function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_FLUSH_ALL
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache flush all
	  function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_INVAL_ALL
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache invalidate
	  all function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_FLUSH_AND_INVAL_ALL
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache flush and
	  invalidate all function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_FLUSH_RANGE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache flush
	  range function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_INVAL_RANGE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache invalidate
	  range function.

config ARCH_HAS_CACHE_FLUSH_AND_INVAL_RANGE
	bool
	help
	  This option indicates that the architecture has a cache flush and
	  invalidate range function.

menu "Kernel"

config KERNEL_ENTRY
	string "Kernel entry point symbol"
	default "_start"
	help
	  This is the entry point symbol for the kernel.

config INIT_STACKS
	bool "Initialize stack areas"
	default y
	help
	  Enable this option to initialize the stack areas of all threads
	  with a known value (0xaa) before they are started. This is useful
	  for debugging stack overflows.

config THREAD_MONITOR
	bool "Enable thread monitoring"
	help
	  This option enables the thread monitoring feature. When enabled,
	  the kernel will monitor the state of each thread and can report
	  if a thread has been starving for a long time.

config THREAD_NAME
	bool "Enable thread name"
	help
	  Enable this option to be able to name threads. This is useful
	  for debugging.

config THREAD_CUSTOM_DATA
	bool "Enable thread custom data"
	help
	  Enable this option to add a custom data field to the thread
	  control block. This can be used by applications to store
	  per-thread data.

config MAX_THREAD_BYTES
	int "Maximum bytes for thread name"
	depends on THREAD_NAME
	range 3 64
	default 3
	help
	  Maximum number of bytes to reserve for a thread's name.
	  Longer names will be truncated. A null terminator will
	  always be present. Minimum value is 3, to account for
	  at least 2 characters plus a null terminator.

config USERSPACE
	bool "Enable user mode and memory domains"
	select MMU if !CPU_HAS_MMU_FLAG_SUPPORT
	select ARCH_HAS_USERSPACE
	help
	  This option enables user mode and memory domain support. When
	  enabled, threads can be run in user mode with restricted
	  privileges and memory access.

config MEM_POOL_HEAP_BACKEND
	bool "Use memory pool as heap backend"
	depends on HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE > 0
	help
	  Enable this option to use a memory pool as the backend for the
	  system heap. This is useful for systems with limited memory.

config HEAP_MEM_POOL_SIZE
	int "Heap memory pool size"
	default 0
	help
	  Size of the heap memory pool in bytes.

config SYS_CLOCK_EXISTS
	bool
	default y
	help
	  This option indicates that a system clock exists.

config SYS_CLOCK_TICKS_PER_SEC
	int "System clock ticks per second"
	default 100
	help
	  The number of system clock ticks per second.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_DEFAULT
	int "Default kernel initialization priority"
	default 40
	help
	  Default priority for kernel initialization objects.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_OBJECTS
	int "Object initialization priority"
	default 30
	help
	  Priority for initializing kernel objects.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_DEVICE
	int "Device initialization priority"
	default 50
	help
	  Priority for initializing devices.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_CONFIG
	int "Configuration initialization priority"
	default 20
	help
	  Priority for initializing configuration.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_PRIMARY
	int "Primary initialization priority"
	default 10
	help
	  Priority for primary initialization.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_PRE_KERNEL_1
	int "Pre-kernel 1 initialization priority"
	default 0
	help
	  Priority for pre-kernel 1 initialization.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_PRE_KERNEL_2
	int "Pre-kernel 2 initialization priority"
	default 0
	help
	  Priority for pre-kernel 2 initialization.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_POST_KERNEL
	int "Post-kernel initialization priority"
	default 90
	help
	  Priority for post-kernel initialization.

config KERNEL_INIT_PRIORITY_APPLICATION
	int "Application initialization priority"
	default 99
	help
	  Priority for application initialization.

config MULTITHREADING
	bool "Enable multithreading"
	default y
	select ARCH_HAS_MULTITHREADING
	help
	  Enable this option to support multiple threads.

config NUM_COOP_PRIORITIES
	int "Number of cooperative priorities"
	default 16
	range 0 256
	help
	  Number of cooperative priorities.

config NUM_PREEMPT_PRIORITIES
	int "Number of preemptible priorities"
	default 16
	range 0 256
	help
	  Number of preemptible priorities.

config MAIN_THREAD_PRIORITY
	int "Main thread priority"
	default 0
	help
	  Priority of the main thread.

config IDLE_THREAD_PRIORITY
	int "Idle thread priority"
	default 15
	help
	  Priority of the idle thread.

config MAIN_STACK_SIZE
	int "Main thread stack size"
	default 1024
	help
	  Size of the main thread stack in bytes.

config IDLE_STACK_SIZE
	int "Idle thread stack size"
	default 256
	help
	  Size of the idle thread stack in bytes.

config ISR_STACK_SIZE
	int "ISR stack size"
	default 2048
	help
	  Size of the ISR stack in bytes.

config SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE
	int "System workqueue stack size"
	default 1024
	help
	  Size of the system workqueue stack in bytes.

config SYSTEM_WORKQUEUE_PRIORITY
	int "System workqueue priority"
	default -1
	help
	  Priority of the system workqueue.

config TIMESLICING
	bool "Enable time slicing"
	help
	  Enable this option to allow time slicing of threads with the
	  same priority.

config TIMESLICE_SIZE
	int "Time slice size"
	default 0
	depends on TIMESLICING
	help
	  Time slice size in system clock ticks.

config TIMESLICE_PRIORITY
	int "Time slice priority"
	default 0
	depends on TIMESLICING
	help
	  Highest priority level at which time slicing is performed.

config POLL
	bool "Enable poll API"
	help
	  Enable this option to support the poll() API.

endmenu # Kernel

''. Check these unsatisfied dependencies: USERSPACE (=n). See

MAX_THREAD_BYTES in the menuconfig/guiconfig interface. The Application Development Primer, Setting
